products.name: Captions AI
products.note: AI video editing; eye contact correction; dubbing; likeness manipulation consent

profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York City. The company describes itself as a tool that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content regardless of a user's editing experience, positioning its product against traditional editing software by automating time-consuming tasks such as scene cutting, B-roll overlay, caption generation, and translated subtitle creation.

The company's primary product, Captions AI, covers a range of AI-driven video capabilities including eye contact correction, dubbing, avatar creation, and what the site calls an "AI twin" feature that lets users generate a digital likeness for use across multiple videos. The platform supports use cases including short-form social videos, ads, tutorials, product demos, real estate listing videos, and talking head content, and the site lists specific tools such as a prompt-to-video generator, a script-to-video tool, a text-based video editor, and a transition editor.

The held facts note that Captions carries a New York law-exposure count of 260, which is notable given that New York has enacted legislation specifically addressing consent requirements around likeness manipulation, an area the product's own feature set directly touches. No litigation cases, MCP server presence, or SEC or patent filings appear in the available data.
